summary: The diff implements all four requirements. REQ-1 is addressed by removing the #pending status from Katha and CommunityPost types in the backend, using a migration to convert pending posts to approved, and ensuring newly added kathas are stored without an approval step. REQ-2 is addressed by adding TTS play/pause/stop controls via useSpeechNarration on the KathaDetail page for both backend and static kathas. REQ-3 is addressed by removing the #pending variant from CommunityPostStatus in the backend and migrating existing pending posts to approved, so all new image/media posts are immediately visible. REQ-4 is partially addressed with staleTime settings visible in useQueries.ts and memoization in Kathayen/Community pages, but full verification is limited by diff truncation.

missing_requirements.requirement: React Query staleTime set to a reasonable value (e.g., 30 seconds) for list pages; Kathayen and Community pages do not flicker; Community post submission does not freeze; no janky scroll/animation issues.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows staleTime values for some queries (currentUserProfile: 5min, isAdmin: 2min, dharmaQuote: 1hr) but the truncated useQueries.ts does not clearly show staleTime configured for the Kathayen (useGetAllKathayen) and Community (useGetApprovedCommunityPosts) list queries at the recommended ~30 seconds. The truncation prevents full verification of all REQ-4 acceptance criteria.

hallucinated_features.description: A full backend migration module converting existing pending community posts to approved status on canister upgrade.
hallucinated_features.reason: The requirements asked for instant approval of new posts going forward, not a migration of historical pending data. The migration.mo file goes beyond what was explicitly requested, though it is a reasonable implementation choice.
